context: Whole group has casual dinner; many voices on simple food joy.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 居酒屋風、皆で、楽しもか!
lines.en: Izakaya-style fun — let's all enjoy ourselves!
lines.style: Loud, generous opening. Claps hands once. Warm Kansai lilt, bright and inviting. The aunt who makes sure everyone feels welcome before the night even starts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Soft, eager — a small smile in her voice. Warm without performance. Hands coming together in gratitude. The quiet generosity of someone who's happy everyone's here.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 熱いうどんも、ようけ、ある。
lines.en: And we've got plenty of hot udon too.
lines.style: Relaxed, matter-of-fact warmth. Leans back in his seat. Kansai drawl on the vowels. Not loud — just making sure everyone knows there's enough to go around.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 味わい、家、ようけありますね!
lines.en: There's so much food here — just like home!
lines.style: Bright, amazed. Quick rhythm, genuine delight. A child noticing abundance and comfort in the same moment. Voice lifts on 'home.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: This feeling — like we can just be ourselves.
lines.style: Quiet observation, small and sure. No performance. A six-year-old saying something that makes the room pause for a moment. Soft, contented.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 皆と関わらん日、寂しいなぁ。
lines.en: I miss this when we're not all together.
lines.style: Warm, confessional. Leans forward slightly. Not sad — just honest. The easy sincerity of someone who knows he's safe saying what he actually feels.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 盛り上がり、ずっと続けような!
lines.en: Let's keep nights like this going forever!
lines.style: Animated, rising energy. Gestures open and inclusive. Kansai enthusiasm — the kind that pulls everyone up with it. Her voice carries the belief that this matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Family really is a treasure, isn't it.
lines.style: Tender, almost to herself. Gentle voice, like she's just said something she's been holding. Warm gaze across the table. Not a question — a quiet affirmation.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: You lot are a damn good family.
lines.style: Soft pride. Kansai warmth, no edge. Light laugh underneath it. The drunk affection that's actually completely sincere. Pats the table once.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Bright, unguarded burst. No hesitation. A child's wholehearted declaration. Voice peaks with joy at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: こんな夜、毎日、ええなぁ!
lines.en: Every night could be like this and I'd be happy.
lines.style: Soft wonder. No performance — just speaking his wish out loud because he feels safe. Small, steady voice. The wisdom of a quiet child.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: That's a beautiful thing to say, really.
lines.style: Tender, genuine. Slower pace. Voice catches just slightly on the weight of what was said. Kansai warmth but soft — he means every word.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: All right then — let's raise our glasses!
lines.style: Commanding warmth. Stands or lifts her drink. Loud, clear, gathering energy. The aunt calling everyone to the moment. Kansai punch on the timing.
